QuestInfo.name: Approach of the Alliance
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# of the Cygnus Knights invited you to\r\n#m130000000#.
QuestInfo.1: When you arrived at #m130000000#, you found many powerful knights, and not a hint of evil. Speak with #p1101002#.
QuestInfo.2: After speaking with #p1101002#, you can tell this is not an evil organization. Besides, an alliance with the Black Mage...This is a serious matter that can't be decided easily.

0.0: Greetings, mystic adventurer. I am #p1101002#, strategist of the Cygnus Knights. I have some important matters to discuss with you. Shall we?\r\n#L0##bCygnus Knights? I heard you guys used to rule this world back in the day. I'm Kaiser. What's on your mind?#l\n#k
0.1: I've heard of your exploits, and I believe you are the right person to help Maple World face our troubles. Would you be willing to come to #m130000000#?

yes.0: Superb. I will be waiting for you.

1.0: Welcome to Ereve. I'm glad you could make it.\r\n#L0##bYeah...what's with all the knights? Is this a trap? I don't like traps.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, goodness, not at all. Hah. Please excuse us...we take our security very seriously, but you have nothing to fear.\r\n#L0##bHm...you guys don't feel evil. Fair enough. So, what did you want to talk about?#l\n#k
1.2: As you know, we are the Cygnus Knights. Our organization opposes the ultimate evil of Maple World, the Black Mage. Recently, the forces of the Black Mage have grown greatly, inspiring us to form a world-wide alliance.\r\n#L0##bBlack Mage...?#l\n#k
1.3: We've asked you here to invite you to join our alliance. You are clearly powerful, and appear to be a champion of justice.\r\n#L0##bAn alliance? Hmmm...#l\n#k
1.4: Is this a difficult decision for you?\r\n#L0##bWell, I've never heard of this Black Mage guy. Also, I represent Nova here on Maple World, so I need to really think about things like this before I decide.#l\n#k
1.5: Indeed. In that case, I apologize for rushing you, and encourage you to consider our proposition. We both have much to gain.

yes.0: Just a moment. It seems #p1101001# has something to tell you.
